output.reason: Professionally resolved dual-panel perfume still life featuring Diptyque and Bella Freud on marble; clean lighting and composition make it a strong design reference despite lacking external campaign typography.

analysis.composition: Split-screen diptych layout; left panel features an angled perspective of a rectangular bottle on a marble slab edge, right panel shows a top-down flat lay of an oval bottle on a flat marble surface.
analysis.negative_space: Generous, dominated by white and light grey marble textures providing a clean backdrop.
analysis.lighting: Bright, soft studio lighting with distinct, directional shadows indicating a single light source per panel, highlighting glass refraction.
analysis.typography: None outside the container; text is limited to product labels (handwritten style on left, classic oval emblem on right).
analysis.information_density: Low; focuses entirely on product form and material texture.
